title: Files on Google Cloud Storage: destination

url.title: URL
url.description: Where the tables go: gs://bucket/prefix. Each stream's table is a directory of files under it.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: The Google Cloud Storage JSON API's endpoint, for one other than Google's, such as fake-gcs-server's. With it and no serviceAccountKey, the connector sends no credentials.

serviceAccountKey.title: Service account key
serviceAccountKey.description: A service account's JSON key, as its text. Without one, Google's default credentials, or none at all with an endpoint, as an emulator takes.

format.title: Format
format.description: The files' format: Parquet, CSV with a header line, or JSON Lines.

compression.title: Compression
compression.description: Parquet: zstd (the default), snappy, gzip or none, inside the file. CSV and JSON Lines: gzip, zstd or none (the default), the whole file, which gets the extension .gz or .zst.

fileSize.title: File size
fileSize.description: Bytes a file reaches, compressed, before the next one starts.

x-groups.title: Location
x-groups.description: Where the files are, and the address of the store's API.

x-groups.title: Files
x-groups.description: How each table's files are written.
